results.content: Amelia Jessica Williams (née Pond) is a fictional character portrayed by Karen Gillan in the long-running British science fiction television series Doctor Who. Amy is a companion "Companion (Doctor Who)") of the series protagonist the Eleventh Doctor, played by Matt Smith. She appears in the programme from the fifth series (2010) to midway through the seventh series "Doctor Who (series 7)") (2012)...

results.title: Karen Gillan - Wikipedia
results.content: Karen Sheila Gillan (/ˈɡɪlən/; born 28 November 1987) is a Scottish actress and filmmaker. She gained recognition for her work in British film and television, particularly for portraying Amy Pond, a primary companion "Companion (Doctor Who)") to the Eleventh Doctor in the science fiction series Doctor Who (2010–2013).
